title: The Trump administration has undercut the U.S. asylum program. These 3 charts show how
description: A new rule for asylum applications adds to the bevy of changes under the Trump administration to the core program for those fleeing persecution in their home countries.

title: Sen. Rand Paul says he'll move to hold Fauci in contempt after combative hearing
description: Dr. Anthony Fauci invoked the Fifth Amendment while appearing before a committee chaired by Sen. Rand Paul. Now, the senator is saying he will move to hold Fauci in contempt.

title: Infectious disease expert on Fauci's Senate hearing face off with lawmakers
description: NPR's Michel Martin speaks with Dr. Céline Gounder about lawmakers' contentious questioning of former top U.S. health official Dr. Anthony Fauci Wednesday.

title: Mamdani says New York doesn’t have authority to arrest Netanyahu, urges feds to act
description: The mayor had said the city might enforce a warrant against the Israeli leader, drawing Democratic criticism. On Tuesday, he urged the U.S. government to do so.

title: As Democrats debate the future of the party, Michigan's voters could have a big say
description: With Democrats sensing a chance to win back the Senate majority, the debate about the direction of the party is intensifying. Nowhere is that tension more fraught for their voters than in Michigan.

title: U.S. and Iran resume attacks. And, Fauci to face Senate questions on COVID pandemic
description: The U.S. and Iran have resumed fighting after Iran attacked U.S. forces in the Middle East yesterday. And, a Senate committee will question Anthony Fauci about the COVID-19 pandemic.

title: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy says he had a 'good meeting' with Trump in Washington
description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said he had a "good meeting" with President Donald Trump Tuesday, as the country seeks to make more weapons in its fight against Russia.

title: Did Zelenskyy get what he needed from his D.C. visit? Former ambassador weighs in
description: NPR's Leila Fadel asks former U.S. Ambassador to Ukraine William Taylor about what President Volodymyr Zelenskyy obtained from his visit to Washington.

title: Senate confirms Jay Clayton as director of national intelligence
description: The Senate confirmed Jay Clayton to oversee the intelligence community, despite Democrats' concerns that he could politicize intelligence at President Trump's direction.

title: To win over working-class voters, Democrats need to stop talking about democracy
description: Working-class voters have moved away from the Democratic Party. Winning them back is key to the party's future, a new reports shows. But first, the messaging has to change.

title: Anthony Fauci invokes Fifth Amendment in Rand Paul Senate hearing
description: At a Senate hearing Wednesday, Anthony Fauci is likely to face questions from Sen. Rand Paul related to the origins of the COVID-19 pandemic. Here's what you need to know

title: Trump asks Supreme Court to overturn $83 million verdict in E. Jean Carroll case
description: Trump’s attorneys asserted a 2024 high court decision granting presidents sweeping immunity for actions taken in office shields him from liability in the case.

title: Conservatives tout Biden tapes as proof of his decline. The audio is more nuanced.
description: Audio of Joe Biden's interviews with a ghostwriter in 2016 and 2017 show him referencing classified materials and occasionally struggling to recall details.
